entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about an order. I... I need to make a return. It's for some cycling shoes I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF78901. I just... I'm so disappointed.

Okay, Sarah, I have your order pulled up here. I see the VeloFit Carbon Pro cycling shoes. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. I've tried everything. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, worn different socks... but they just give me terrible blisters on every ride. I really thought these would be the ones.

I understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key. Let me just check the purchase date here... Okay, it looks like they were delivered about 75 days ago.

Oh, I know it's been a while. I kept trying to make them work. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really saved up for these. With the holidays coming, I really needed this money... I was hoping I could still get a refund.
I completely understand, Sarah. Please hold on for just one moment while I review our policy for you.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and you're in luck. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're at day 75, you are well within the window to return these cycling shoes.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive and process the return, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. You should see it in 3-5 business days after that.
Thank you, Alex. You have no idea what a help this is. I really appreciate it. You've made my day.
You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
